module: Flowgraph node "Move Vehicle Group" (default category). Teleports all vehicles of a group (vehicleIds) to a new position, rotation and formation with core_multiSpawn.placeGroup. Pins: shuffle, spawnMode (roadAhead, roadBehind, traffic, lineAhead, lineBehind, lineLeft, lineRight, lineAbove, raceGrid, raceGridAlt; default road), spawnGap (15), startPos, startRot; option data.instantTeleport. Outputs: flow (after the move) and moved pulse.
notes: The default of spawnMode is 'road', which is not in the list of offered modes (inferred from code).

onNodeReset.desc: Resets the state to 0 and forgets the ids.

onVehicleGroupRespawned.desc: Hook called when a group has been replaced; goes to state 2 if the first id matches.

vehIds.desc: table of the replaced group's ids

postInit.desc: Defines the preset values of the spawnMode pin.

work.desc: State machine: 0 launches placeGroup, 1 waits for onVehicleGroupRespawned, 2 emits moved, 3 lets the flow through.
